verdict.note: a null verdict means the run measured nothing, not that the budget passed

not_established: This is one development host over loopback. The master plan budgets are stated for four cores, 8 GiB, a LAN and 100 Mbit/s symmetric; these figures are not comparable to them and no budget is claimed as met.
No capacity population was reached: the reference profile is 250 accounts, 100 channels and one million messages; this run measured a few dozen on an idle server.
No ramp, no two-hour peak, no 24-hour soak, no mixed private traffic under load, and no media.
No host qualification: this ran on a developer machine, not on the Windows or Linux Docker deployments.
